name: adaptive-engineering
description: Project-first engineering with code simplicity rules and explicit learning to a local knowledge vault.

interface.longDescription: Inspect existing project patterns before coding, debugging, refactoring, or review. Keep changes simple and validate them with focused checks. Guided setup creates or connects a local vault; explicit learn requests save candidate knowledge and GitHub references there. Requires local filesystem access and Python for helper scripts.
defaultPrompt: Set up my Adaptive Engineering knowledge vault.
Find the closest existing implementation for this task and make the smallest coherent change.
Learn this material and save a concise candidate note to my configured engineering vault.
